summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests AN9025, a pan-RAS inhibitor taken as an oral capsule, in adults with advanced or metastatic solid tumors that have RAS mutations. Participants take AN9025 by mouth every day or once a week until the disease gets worse, side effects become severe, or they leave the study. The main goal is to find doses that are safe and tolerable and to learn what medical problems occur with the drug.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 prueba AN9025, un inhibidor pan-RAS que se toma en cápsulas orales, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o metastásicos que tienen mutaciones en RAS. Los participantes toman AN9025 por vía oral todos los días o una vez por semana hasta que la enfermedad empeore, aparezcan efectos secundarios graves o decidan retirarse del estudio. El objetivo principal es encontrar dosis seguras y bien toleradas y conocer los problemas médicos que aparecen con el medicamento.
who_for: Age 18 or older and able to give informed consent.
Estimated life expectancy of at least 12 weeks, per the investigator.
Advanced or metastatic cancer that kept growing after available standard treatment.
Documented KRAS, NRAS or HRAS mutation, and agreement to provide tumor tissue.
not_for: Prior treatment with a pan-RAS(ON) inhibitor, with a backfill-cohort exception.
Symptomatic brain or central nervous system cancer or metastasis.
Pregnancy, planned pregnancy, or plans to breastfeed.
Moderate or severe heart disease, or certain heart rhythm or QT risk factors.
Use of strong CYP3A4 or P-gp interacting drugs, or inability to stop proton pump inhibitors.
